svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Cut two 149 mm lengths of 20 x 3 mm flat bar.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Round both ends to a 10 mm radius.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Drill 6.6 mm, 10 mm from each end: 129.2 mm between centres.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: This length sets the panel tilt of 40 degrees.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Drill the two struts clamped together so the holes match.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fit: the lower end bolts to the inside of the plate clip, the upper

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: end to the inside of the low panel clip; one M6 bolt each end.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: The strut rises at 38 degrees and passes 10 mm above the sun shield.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: hole centres 129.2 mm apart, within 0.5 mm; a shorter strut

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: tips the panel steeper, a longer one flatter.
